title: Feedback triage (Globe Quest)
question: What kind of feedback is this, for the Globe Quest app's issue tracker?

choices.bug: something is broken: an error, crash, wrong behaviour, a feature that does not work
choices.feature_request: asks for something new that does not exist yet
choices.ui_ux: works, but is confusing, hard to read, awkward or ugly to use
choices.content_correction: a fact in the content is wrong or outdated: a place, date, visa rule, price, translation, source
choices.noise: not actionable: a test, spam, gibberish, a greeting, or a comment with no request or problem

rubric: Categories are the widget's own (hq/globe_quest/src/app/api/feedback/route.ts CATEGORY_LABELS: Bug, Feature Request, UI/UX, Content correction, General), with General split into 'noise' because the useful question for a tracker is whether anything should be done. Globe Quest is an interactive-globe app: places, quests, journeys, dossiers, a learning journal, circles, relocation guides and visa data.
labeller: Hand-written and hand-labelled by the Claude Opus 5.5 session running brief 05. Real issues on alibad/globe_quest were NOT read: their bodies are user-submitted text.
